TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Ynna dming-ding [kmæih-kahier] alei ka assi kamou ding-ding-auh [kmæih-kahier.]
S.TRANSL: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
「你們不要論斷人，免得你們被論斷。

S.FORM: Ka tou dading-ding-en ki mamang ni-dming-ding-kamou, dingding-auh-kamou-râ: ka tou rarpung-en ki mamang ka ni-rmarpung-kamou, rarpung-auh-kamou-râ.
S.TRANSL: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
因為你們怎樣論斷人，也必怎樣被論斷；你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們。

S.FORM: Ka kaumang ka k'ita-en-hou ta houka ka tou matta ki tæ'iapara oho, râ ælogh [ka pærænæh] ka tou matta oho assi ymhou pou-liliht-in?
S.TRANSL: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
為甚麼看見你弟兄眼中有刺，卻不想自己眼中有樑木呢？

S.FORM: Nda mattæi-mam'-ah-kow ki mang ki tæi-appara oho, ha-miau-mau ta houka tou matta oho, ka kytt'ei, akou-ælogh tou matta-oho?
S.TRANSL: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
你自己眼中有樑木，怎能對你弟兄說：『容我去掉你眼中的刺』呢？

S.FORM: [Ymhou ka] pa-nni-nni-en ki rÿh ki sou, ha-aurou-au ta ælogh tou matta-oho, dou-miaka mara-rau-ah-kow ki 'ææu-matta-au'mhou ta houka tou matta ki tæi-apara-oho.
S.TRANSL: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
你這假冒為善的人！先去掉自己眼中的樑木，然後才能看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。

S.FORM: Ynna pi'æ̈ tou assou-assou-an ki ni-pa-sa-nni tou tatamd-en ki Alid, ynna maring ta vahto-oumi ka tæi-qua tou koudo smaki-qua tou kavou-voulou-an, alei ka assi hmitgid-ah ki anna ki na kourkour nein, ka dou ni-mæ̈eu-vering kmavys-ah ymoumi-æn-ra.
S.TRANSL: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
不要把聖物給狗，也不要把你們的珍珠丟在豬前，恐怕牠踐踏了珍珠，轉過來咬你們。」

S.FORM: Tmoumimi-â, ka 'pæ-eih-kamou: kmi-ym-â ka ma-ki-valei-ah-kamou: tmubtib-â ka 'æ̈æulb-eih-kamou.
S.TRANSL: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
「你們祈求，就給你們；尋找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。

S.FORM: Ka timamang ta tmoumimia, mara ta teni: [timamang] ta kmakiym, maki-valei ta teni: [timamang] ka tmubtub, 'æ̈æulb-eih ta teni.
S.TRANSL: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
因為凡祈求的，就得着；尋找的，就尋見；叩門的，就給他開門。

S.FORM: Timang lava ymoumi-æn, ka rou tmoumimia tyni-æn ta alak tyn ki paoul, p'æ-eih tyn kaua ki vahto?
S.TRANSL: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
你們中間誰有兒子求餅，反給他石頭呢？

S.FORM: Ka rou tmoumimia lava tyni-æn ki thing, pæ-eil-ato tyn kaua ki na voelei?
S.TRANSL: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
求魚，反給他蛇呢？

S.FORM: Heirou mavana-kamou ta ymoumi ka ma't-e ki kidi hmariou ki alalak-oumi ki pæp-æp-æ ka mariang, assi kaua pæ'æ̈-saoun-ah ta Raraman-oumi ka tou tounnoun ki vullu-vullum, pæ'æ̈-ouryf ki riang neini-æn ka tmoumimia tyni-æn?
S.TRANSL: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
你們雖然不好，尚且知道拿好東西給兒女，何況你們在天上的父，豈不更把好東西給求他的人嗎？

S.FORM: Anna ta ymmid ki mamang ka kamoei-'noumi ka paämt-tin ymoumi-æn ki taou, atta ta paämt-au-moumi neini-æn-da: Ka kma-hynna ta na Tatouhko ki na Tama-mattæi-tan-appa.
S.TRANSL: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
所以，無論何事，你們願意人怎樣待你們，你們也要怎樣待人，因為這就是律法和先知的道理。」

S.FORM: Sa-rarbo-a tou nḡataf ka malyngud: alei ka mahæu-ei ta nḡataf, ka mahai-jahei ta darang ka pa-sahka-quan tou si-dada'n, ka mabatoung ta sa-rarbo ki anna.
S.TRANSL: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
「你們要進窄門。因為引到滅亡，那門是寬的，路是大的，進去的人也多；

S.FORM: Ka masi-idd ta nḡataf, ka malyng-udd ta darang ka paouhkaquan tou kæuag-han, ka matityng ta maki-valei ki anna.
S.TRANSL: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
引到永生，那門是窄的，路是小的，找着的人也少。」

S.FORM: Râ Saou-kavier-â ki mattæi-tan mattæi-harang ka iroua ymoumi-æn tou pamammi-'en ka na jocko, râ tou-rbo-appa [mama ki] kmkakan joekko ta neni.
S.TRANSL: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
「你們要防備假先知。他們到你們這裏來，外面披着羊皮，裏面卻是殘暴的狼。

S.FORM: K'alang-au-moumi ta neni tou voua nein-ra. Pia-sâl-en kaua pihtygh ta karæumætæh tou adad-dum-an? ki kamaija lava tou eyhg-au-an?
S.TRANSL: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
憑着他們的果子，就可以認出他們來。荊棘上豈能摘葡萄呢？蒺藜裏豈能摘無花果呢？

S.FORM: K'ma-appa hynna ymmid ki pærænnæh ka mariang makka-voua ki voua ka mariang, pærænnæh ka assi mariang makka-voua ki voua ka assi mariang.
S.TRANSL: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
這樣，凡好樹都結好果子，惟獨壞樹結壞果子。

S.FORM: Assi hmahei makka-voua ta pærænnæh ka mariang ki voua ka assi mariang: pærænnæh-appa ka assi mariang [assi hmahei] makka-voua ki voua ka mariang.
S.TRANSL: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
好樹不能結壞果子；壞樹不能結好果子。

S.FORM: Ymmid ki pærænnæh k'assi makka-voua ki voua ka mariang tætætæ-en-ato ka-aryng-ato tou apoei-ra.
S.TRANSL: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
凡不結好果子的樹就砍下來，丟在火裏。

S.FORM: Anna ta k'alang-au-moumi tou voua nyn ta neni.
S.TRANSL: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
所以，憑着他們的果子就可以認出他們來。」

S.FORM: Assi sa-rarbo-ah tou Peisasou-an ki tounnoun ki vullu-vullum ta mæi-bouvoual ka ma-nanang jau-an Meirang, Meirang: râ dyk tyni-æn ka ahqua ki kamoei-in ti Rama-au ka æ'iä-tounnoun ki vullu-vullum.
S.TRANSL: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
「凡稱呼我『主啊，主啊』的人不能都進天國；惟獨遵行我天父旨意的人才能進去。

S.FORM: Mabatoung ta kmæ'igh k'maah-hynna ki sou, Meirang, Meirang, assi-kame kaua ni-mattæi-tan tou Nanang oho, assi-kame kaua ni-padarang tou Nanang oho ki Lyttou, assi-kame kaua ni-meiring-ei-appa tou Nanang oho ki madagh ki ringei ki kailh-en.
S.TRANSL: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
當那日必有許多人對我說：『主啊，主啊，我們不是奉你的名傳道，奉你的名趕鬼，奉你的名行許多異能嗎？』

S.FORM: Ka tou kidi kanna mattæi-pænæh-ah-koh ki sou neini-an, Myhkaqua assi-mau-kamou ni-k'alang-en, d'marang-â jau-an ymoumi ka mapoungas [miroung] tou katoukoul-an.
S.TRANSL: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
我就明明地告訴他們說：『我從來不認識你們，你們這些作惡的人，離開我去吧！』」

S.FORM: Anna ta ymmid ki mæi'bouvoual ka millingigh ki sousou-au k'atta, dou ahqua, pæhkaulaul'au-mau tyni æn ki pæræh ka macynnæu, ka ni-mei-ringei ki tallah tyn tou [voukyn ka] vahto.
S.TRANSL: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
「所以，凡聽見我這話就去行的，好比一個聰明人，把房子蓋在磐石上；

S.FORM: Ka ni-mou-rarim ta dumdum, ka ni-iroua ta vaha, ni-bavare ta vare ka ni-smiryf ki tallah k'anna, ka assi ni-matub-da, alei ka ni-'ærag-han ki vahto-ra.
S.TRANSL: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
雨淋，水沖，風吹，撞着那房子，房子總不倒塌，因為根基立在磐石上。

S.FORM: Ka ymmud ki mæ'i-boävoual ka millingigh ki sousou-au k'atta, dou assi ahqua, pæhkaulaul'aul-ato ki pæræh ka rmapourapou, ka ni-mei-ring-ei ki tallah tyn tou li'igh.
S.TRANSL: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
凡聽見我這話不去行的，好比一個無知的人，把房子蓋在沙土上；

S.FORM: Ka ni-mou-rarim ta dumdum, ka ni-iroua ta vaha, ni-bavare ta vare, ka ni-smiryf ki tallah kanna, ka ni-matub-da, ka ni-maloäf ta pa-at'b-an tyn da.
S.TRANSL: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
雨淋，水沖，風吹，撞着那房子，房子就倒塌了，並且倒塌得很大。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'mato hynna, ka pat'-kaha'to ta ti Jesus ki sou k'atta, ka ni-innagh ta mako-ilalaulau alei ki ni-pæhtæutæuuh-en tynda.
S.TRANSL: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
耶穌講完了這些話，眾人都希奇他的教訓；

S.FORM: Alei ka ni-matatæutæuugh neini-æn, mama ki akou-keirang-en ki kidi, assi mama ki Makou-sasoulat.
S.TRANSL: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
因為他教訓他們，正像有權柄的人，不像他們的文士。
